values.note: Four sites (10, 12, 14, 16) book on MyCountyParks up to a year ahead and at least 7 days out; the rest are first come, first served, paid by the post's QR code or cash envelope at the kiosk, and an unreserved reservable site can be taken first-come (online payment only). No online reservations in the off-season. Reservations non-refundable. After 14 nights campers must leave for 3 nights.

note: Butler County Conservation area on the Shell Rock River at the fieldstone dam, 23525 Camp Comfort Rd north of C-23. 38 electric sites (30/50 amp; most grass pads, pairs sharing a pedestal) on a lane along the river, plus tent space; water hydrants, shower house, boat ramps and canoe access above and below the dam, open shelter, playground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 first-come / $25 reservable + $4, 38 electric 30/50-amp sites, showers, no dump. Added season (May 1-Oct 15), booking details (4 reservable sites, 1 year ahead, 7 days minimum lead, weekend 2-night min, 14-night limit), water hydrants and flush toilets. Waterfront up-lead riverview -> riverfront.
flags: WATERFRONT UP-LEAD riverview -> riverfront: the campground lane runs along the west bank of the Shell Rock just above the fieldstone dam, with the sites on open mowed grass between the lane and a riprap bank. On Esri (200 m frame), the parked trailer sits about 15 m from the water, with no trees, road or day-use strip between; the lane is behind the sites, on the landward side. The river is about 55-70 m wide (riverfront, not creekside). The county's photo from the shelter shows a row of RVs on the open bank, right at the water; the site photos show a table and pedestal on grass with the river 15-25 m beyond. This holds for the row of sites along the bank (most of the campground). The few sites near the north loop and the south end by the shelter house and road sit behind trees.
PHONE MISSING: Butler County Conservation Board 319-346-6551 (on the site pages, 'Call for Availability').
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: no pad lengths are posted; the sites are grass pads on an open lane, and the photos show full-size travel trailers on the bank.
SITE COUNT: MyCountyParks lists 4 reservable sites (10, 12, 14, 16) and non-reservable sites 01-08 and 17-28 (24 listings); the park page says 38 electric sites. Kept 38.
PIN OK: 42.84384,-92.76090 is in the woods about 25 m west of the campground lane, roughly 40 m from the sites (well under 250 m).
